narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>A square hole needs four cuts, one for each side, so I will cut four times.
<bookmark mark='mess'/>Cutting four times by hand makes the sides uneven, and the corners rarely meet.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>The folded layers can repeat one cut for us, and all four sides come out equal.
removed_beats.on_screen: Chintu's bubble says a square hole needs four cuts; a sheet with four separate cuts is shown with a messy uneven hole; the bubble is struck through in the warning colour

narration: <bookmark mark='check'/>To check, measure the sides of the hole. All the sides should be equal.
<bookmark mark='corner'/>Also check the corners, because a square needs square corners and not only equal sides.
removed_beats.on_screen: the stage clears except the anchor; the recap board shows the check: the hole should have four equal sides and four square corners, as a square does
